materialFindings: Starting/probable starting defensive tackle Alfred Collins tore his patellar tendon in Tuesday practice in Melbourne and is out for the 2026 season.
San Francisco had already lost defensive end Sam Okuayinonu to a broken foot, leaving the defensive front materially thinner before the Rams opener.

Available interior replacements are inexperienced: Osa Odighizuwa, CJ West and rookie Gracen Halton are the primary options; Halton has also been limited by an ankle issue and James Thompson Jr. has missed practice with a hamstring issue.
Nick Bosa remains on track to play, but Kyle Shanahan has not committed to a normal workload as Bosa returns from ACL rehabilitation.
